status: Implementation and export checkpoint; component acceptance and native qualification remain separate
implemented: Rebuilt scalp support against the actual retained head instead of an approximate ellipsoid for crop/fade construction.
Removed exposed loose-hair scalp skirt construction; reused developed cartoon root topology with newly shaped falling lengths.
Built denser open curl clusters over recessed support, plus real vertex-density and short-grain taper.
Constructed separate twin gathers, woven braids, compact wrapped buns, and smoother loc ends.
Rebuilt hat crowns/brims and continuous pashmina drape/ends.
Separated thin transmitting lenses from frames and corrected planar lens normals to remove false prism distortion.
Exported ordinary uncompressed GLBs in the original shared coordinates; consolidated only within component/material roles.
Added a bounded-cache review viewer, full angle controls, separate visibility, four tones and matched exported-asset references.

visual_review.construction: Reviewed source renders; multiple corrections made for coverage, attachment, clipping and lens distortion.

passes: Source construction views, followed by geometry and fit corrections
Reopened ordinary GLB: front, three-quarter, both profiles, rear, top, underside and body
Four skin tones at128px; derived32/48/64px readability sheets
final_exports.scope: 25 individual looks. No base body, face, wardrobe or selected224 ponytail/cap replacement.
final_exports.small_portrait_findings: Eyes and main hair silhouettes remain readable. Gem/sprout details diminish at32px. Existing224 masculine stubble becomes faint at small sizes and was not changed in this slice.
